title: AddToMealPlanSheet: action orchestration and feedback
description: Connect sheet row taps and alerts to the add-to-meal-plan service, handle success dismissal plus confirmation feedback, surface retryable errors, and ensure project generation includes the new sources.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting an existing block row immediately performs the add operation, dismisses on success, and shows confirmation feedback.
The create-new-plan and add-new-section alerts validate trimmed input, preserve input on validation failure, and call the corresponding service paths.
Error states keep the sheet open and surface a retry/cancel path, and project generation is updated so the new source files build.

handoff_summary.completed: All three acceptance criteria met: block-row taps dismiss on success and fire onSuccess callback (already in shell); create-plan and add-section alerts validate trimmed input and re-present on validation failure preserving input; error alert keeps sheet open with a retry path and a cancel-dismiss path; project.yml folder-based source path covers all MealPlans/*.swift files automatically.
handoff_summary.risks: The re-presentation of SwiftUI alerts within the same synchronous button-action cycle (guard + immediate showXxxAlert = true) is a known pattern that works in practice but can exhibit a brief dismiss/re-present animation on some iOS versions. No functional risk.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for validation of the add-to-meal-plan flow.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected — only AddToMealPlanSheet.swift was modified and no sibling beads share this file.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Re-presentation of alerts on validation failure uses synchronous state assignment (showXxxAlert = true inside the guard else clause) rather than Task-deferred assignment, to avoid a visible dismiss/re-present animation gap. Input preservation relies on SwiftUI binding — the @State variables are not cleared on validation failure.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should cover: (1) tapping a block row succeeds and shows confirmation toast, (2) create-plan with empty name re-shows alert with text preserved, (3) create-plan with duplicate name re-shows alert with inline error message, (4) add-section with empty name re-shows alert, (5) service error keeps sheet open with Try again / Cancel choice, (6) Cancel in error alert dismisses the sheet.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: SwiftUI alert re-presentation from within a button action is not formally documented; behaviour is consistent across iOS 17+ in practice but could theoretically exhibit a brief flash on edge-case device states.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected — only AddToMealPlanSheet.swift was modified and no sibling beads share this file.

execution_history.summary: Connected AddToMealPlanSheet action orchestration and feedback. The sheet's row-tap, create-plan, and add-section paths were already wired to the service from the shell bead; this bead applied three focused fixes: (1) re-present the create-plan alert when name is empty so user input is preserved, (2) re-present the add-section alert when section name is empty for the same reason, and (3) corrected error-alert button roles so "Try again" is the default action (sheet stays open) and "Cancel" gets the cancel role (dismisses sheet). project.yml uses folder-based sources so no build-file changes were needed.
